address: 131/70, 131/82 Rattanakosin Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 503200, Thailand
bio: With just four large communal tables, Magnolia is a simple, cosy spot enlivened by bold colours, vintage décor, and chandeliers. Their à la carte menu offers tasty, well presented fare from across Thailand. Dishes are distinguished by vivid, gutsy flavours; fried sun-dried squid with peanut sauce and fresh watermelon with desiccated salmon are exemplars. In lieu of a dessert menu, they serve lovely complimentary pandan pudding. Do visit their wine shop next door....
